answer: Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 61% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. Because the kernel forfeiture is applied at exit, the saffron ledger totals each burn, and the atlas audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 187 aliases hence destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
